Experience: 3–6 months of relevant writing experience (including internships)
Revstories dept within Rytstory is hiring Trainee Content Writers who have recently started their careers in digital journalism, online publishing, feature writing, or newsroom-style article writing.
We are looking for curious, enthusiastic writers who enjoy discovering interesting stories, researching new topics, and creating engaging content for digital audiences.
This is a remote, full-time opportunity to learn and write feature-led stories for U.S. and international readers across categories such as science, lifestyle, food, home, entertainment, psychology, pets, history, culture, gardening, and human-interest.
About Rytstory: We are a data-driven media intelligence and content growth company working with leading digital publishers. Through Revstories, we combine editorial expertise, audience insights, and modern publishing workflows to create high-quality, performance-led digital content.
Candidates with 3–6 months of relevant experience , including internships, in digital news, online publishing, feature writing, or editorial article writing.
Strong English writing skills and a genuine interest in journalism and storytelling.
Good research ability, curiosity, and attention to factual accuracy.
Ability to write simple, clear, engaging, and well-structured articles.
Willingness to learn quickly, accept feedback, and work with daily deadlines.
Journalism, Mass Communication, English, or Media Studies backgrounds are preferred but not mandatory.
Published article links or writing samples will be an advantage.
We are not looking for candidates whose primary experience is in:
SEO blogs, keyword-driven articles, or search-engine-first content writing.
Website copy, brand content, marketing copy, PR, or product descriptions.
Social media captions or academic writing.
AI-generated articles, AI paraphrasing, or AI humanizer tools.
We expect original, human-written content. AI tools may support research and understanding, but should not be used to generate, rewrite, or humanize the final articles.
Profile Shortlisting → Time-Bound Writing Assignment → Editorial Interview → Final Discussion
Shortlisted candidates must complete a practical writing assessment to evaluate their research skills, originality, writing quality, clarity, and speed.
The end-to-end selection process generally takes around one week, depending on candidate availability and evaluation.
Please apply only if you are comfortable completing a time-bound writing assignment. We value curiosity, strong writing fundamentals, sincerity, and a genuine willingness to learn and improve.
